source_snapshot.title: Dubai's Al Furjan gets paid parking: What residents need to know
source_snapshot.text: Dubai: Paid public parking has been introduced in Al Furjan, with motorists now required to pay parking fees in designated areas under zone code 591P.Parkin announced the implementation of the parking tariffs in a social media post, confirming that signboards have been installed to identify the designated paid parking areas..Get updated faster and for FREE: Download the Gulf News app now - simply click here.. Residents and visitors can pay for parking by the hour at the applicable rates or opt for subscription packages.Parking timings and zone codeAccording to Parkin, the designated parking areas in Al Furjan operate under the following arrangements:Parking zone: 591PPaid parking hours: 8am to midnightPayment options: Hourly parking or subscription plansMotorists are advised to check the signboards installed at their parking locations or use the Parkin app for the applicable hourly tariffs.How much do parking subscriptions cost?Parkin has also announced subscription packages for motorists who regularly use public parking spaces in Al Furjan.The subscription rates are:One month: Dh672Three months: Dh1,999Six months: Dh3,999One year: Dh4,999The annual subscription offers a lower monthly equivalent than the shorter packages, making it an option for residents who frequently park in designated areas.How to pay for parkingMotorists can use the Parkin app to access parking information, check applicable charges and pay for parking.Those opting for hourly parking should refer to the rates displayed on the signboards or in the app before paying.Parkin has urged motorists to follow the designated parking signs and use its official app for further information.

source_verification.reason: All factual claims in the post are directly supported by the source text.

Стоимость подписок: месяц — 672 дирхама, год — 4999 дирхамов.
Оплатить парковку можно через приложение Parkin, где также указаны тарифы и зоны.
